The agreement outlines the process for marketing and selling shares of GWG stock held by the trusts. Key sections include the term (one year or until sales complete), termination rights (mutual, by Trust Advisors, or by Bank with notice), assignment restrictions (limited to liquidating trusts), and governing law (New York). No specific monetary contract value is stated in the OMA itself; compensation is deferred to a separate Engagement Letter. No renewal terms are present as the term expires automatically.
